title: VTC→Chat guide: auto-creating call Chats
description: Section on server-side Chat lifecycle for calls. When to create a Chat (on VTCCall create? on first participant join?). Chat kind (group for standalone calls, channel binding for Space calls). Chat membership mirroring VTCCall participants. Chat cleanup when call ends (keep for history or archive). JSON example of server creating a Chat and binding it via chatId.
